correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md:30–66 and inspected VERIFICATION.md and verify.py. Continuity of det(I−tA) from 1 and nonsingularity on the full domain give its positive sign. The adjugate numerator of every difference has degree at most n−1 and zero constant term because the demand shocks and gross-output weights have the stated unit normalization. For n=2 the factored numerator is constant and for n=3 affine; empty, full, or one-sided sign intervals (including ties) remain intervals under intersection. The n=1 winner set is all of (0,1). Independently solved the sparse transposed score equations in order 2,3,1,4: m2=1, m3=1+t/2, m1=1+(3t/4)m3, m4=1+t(m1/3+4/9). This gives m1>m3>m2 and m4−m1=t(t−1/3)(t−2/3)/8, including the exact ties and the absence of any other dominating sector. For the positive matrix, the largest column sum is 1759/2250; its score vector equals the sparse score vector divided by 1−(t/1000) sum_j m_j(t), by substituting the rank-one perturbation into the score equations. The scalar denominator is positive (also follows from positivity of both score vectors). Exact rational replay at 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 gives the positive-matrix gaps 6000/3453491, 2000/1149013, 6000/687631, respectively. This independent method does not run the uploaded verifier. In fact this special perturbation preserves all crossings; the frozen record conservatively claims only the sample-point re-entrance. In the prior-work prose, 'leave and re-enter first place twice' should be read against the precise Finding: there are two switches, not two separate returns.

value.rationale: The sharp threshold answers when a policy-independent column-sum ranking can actually lose and recover an overall leader, not merely permit one pairwise crossover. The all-orders obstruction below four and strictly positive witness are useful together: the return is not an effect of zero coefficients, topology changes or a singularity. Total gross output is not welfare or value added.
